name: Cleric Primal Growler
body:
Divinely gifted with the ability to create terrifying vocalizations, primal growlers excel at cowing their foes, intimidating their targets into submission.

A primal growler has the following class features.

Domains

A primal growler gains only one domain which must be the Animal domain (or the Fur subdomain).

This alters domains.

Menacing Growl (Ex)

Primal growlers gain a +1 morale bonus on Intimidate skill checks. This bonus increases by +1 for every 5 cleric levels, to a maximum of +5 at 20th level. If a primal growler selects any sort of canine as an animal companion, they gain a circumstance bonus on Intimidate skill checks equal to 1/2 their cleric level anytime their companion is within 30 feet of them. This in conjunction with intimidating attack replaces the second domain.

Intimidating Attack (Ex)

At 1st level, after a successful melee attack, a primal growler can attempt to demoralize their target as a swift action (rather than the typical standard action), gaining a sacred bonus on their Intimidate check equal to their Wisdom modifier. The primal growler can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + their Wisdom modifier, but no more than once per round. At 8th level, the target cowers, taking a –2 penalty to Armor Class and loses his Dexterity bonus (if any).

“This in conjunction with menacing growl replaces the second domain.
